description: ごみの収集量と搬入先処理状況の推移 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 目黒区. ごみの収集量と搬入先処理状況の推移。 1日当たりの排出量は、年度の総量を365日（うるう年の2月29日を含む年度は366日）で除したもの。 持ち込みごみ量は、臨時持込のみの数値。. Coverage: 目黒区. The portal files it under the publisher 目黒区. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
